title: Correct expression for Δm
description: Essential: The student's final answer for Δm must match Δm = (M m a)/(V ρ g) or an algebraically equivalent form.

title: Correct expression for m₁
description: Essential: The student's final answer for m₁ must match m₁ = m (ρ g H₁ + p₀)/(ρ g H + p₀) or an algebraically equivalent form.

title: Applies Newton's second law
description: Important: The solution must apply F_net = Ma, relating the net buoyant force (ρgΔV) to the fish's mass and acceleration.

title: Uses Boyle's Law correctly
description: Important: The solution must apply pV = constant for the isothermal gas in chamber B, relating pressures at depths H and H₁ to the volume change ΔV.

title: Relates gas mass to density and volume
description: Important: The solution must correctly use the relation Δm = ρ_gas ΔV, where ρ_gas = m/V, to connect the gas mass transfer to the volume change.

title: Identifies hydrostatic pressures
description: Important: The solution must state the external pressure at a depth h as p₀ + ρ g h.

title: Considers initial force equilibrium
description: Optional: The solution may note the initial stationary condition at depth H implies Mg = ρgV₀, defining the initial fish volume V₀.

title: Sign error in force equation
description: Pitfall: Penalise if the net force equation is written as Mg - F_b' = Ma, incorrectly reversing the buoyancy and weight forces.

title: Pressure or volume mix-up in Boyle's Law
description: Pitfall: Penalise if Boyle's Law is misapplied, e.g., using p₁V = p₂(V+ΔV) for the H₁ < H case instead of p₁(V-ΔV)=p₂V.

title: Unit inconsistency or omission
description: Pitfall: Penalise if final answers are presented without any implied or stated units, or if units are inconsistent within the derivation.
